params.name: from
params.description: The first page of the interval of the brand list.

params.name: to
params.description: The last page of the interval of the brand list.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The order that the list is displayed. You can select `name`, or `updated_at` to select the order criteria. Then you can add `,` , `asc` or `desc` to define the brands order.
